entries.39bab5915eb975d6: Operating revenue, affected by the expansion of the novel coronavirus infection, fell to ¥224 million in the fiscal year ended September 2021 and ¥502 million in the fiscal year ended September 2022, but recovered to ¥2,945 million in the fiscal year ended September 2023, ¥4,598 million in the fiscal year ended September 2024, and ¥4,787 million in the fiscal year ended September 2025. entries.41925724bc470da0: This is the single segment of the group. The company plans and sells original self-produced tours focused on sightseeing content with the themes of nature, culture, art and humanity, covering the whole world. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,787 million; within sales of merchandise, travel agency business accounted for ¥4,773 million and other sales (income from insurance premium commissions) for ¥13 million. Travel fees are received as advance payments, and the company continues to operate without borrowings.

The number of travelers on hosted tours with tour conductors for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was 6,712 in total.

entries.50d0d4277ad319e1: Its strengths are a lineup of travel products that strongly emphasize the intellectual themes of nature, culture, art and people, and trained tour escort services. It runs high-quality tours, for example by enabling sightseeing time to be enriched without stopping at duty-free shops for commissions. Tour escorts are trained by consolidated subsidiary Eurasia Service, and the company dispatches dedicated escorts who are thoroughly familiar with the regions it handles and its own itineraries. The company states that enhancing the intellectual capacity and service capability of its people is its greatest management challenge, and it advocates management that emphasizes fairness, transparency and accountability.

entries.c7af57d123fab4b6: EURASIA TRAVEL Co.,Ltd. is an overseas travel specialist travel agency established in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo in 1986. It has one consolidated subsidiary, and consolidated headcount as of September 30, 2025 was 93. Its head office is in Hirakawacho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.

entries.ea6fa6dd9ef544a2: This is the company's core business.
entries.efd45ff69d936dbb: A travel company that sells its own planned overseas tour packages set in more than 170 countries around the world, on the themes of nature, culture and art.
entries.f34380b74712bf03: The company's main customers are mature individual travelers who strongly seek intellectual satisfaction and spiritual enjoyment when traveling overseas. It has a customer base centered on repeat customers, and is also developing products for inbound and affluent individual travelers as well as planned products with influencers.
entries.f908c44b825c0138: The company states that its basic management policy is to sell its own overseas travel programs across more than 170 countries worldwide, targeting mature customers who strongly seek intellectual satisfaction and spiritual enjoyment when traveling overseas. The core of its medium- to long-term management strategy is to win the support of its core target of intellectually and spiritually mature customers and to steadily expand the customers in that segment. Rather than brokering tickets that anyone could arrange, it aims to hold specialized areas that only it can offer, win customer trust by producing travel products, and survive within the industry. As priority issues to address, it cites sales activities focused on regions with high safety, price pass-through of the effects of exchange rate fluctuations, and investment to increase sales and reduce expenses using DX/AI.
entries.fc2867cadcc03e8b: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥113 million.
